nodes.description: Read every video frame and emit synchronized timing metadata.
nodes.name: file
nodes.pseudo_code:
cap = cv2.VideoCapture('test_video.mp4')
if not cap.isOpened(): raise FileNotFoundError('test_video.mp4')
reported_fps = cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)
fps = reported_fps if reported_fps > 0 else 12.0
frame_index = 0
try:
    while True:
        ok, frame = cap.read()
        if not ok: break
        timestamp_ms = cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC)
        timestamp_s = timestamp_ms / 1000.0 if timestamp_ms > 0 else frame_index / fps
        metadata = {'frame_index': frame_index, 'timestamp_s': timestamp_s, 'fps': fps}
        emit(p01of=frame, p01om=metadata)
        frame_index += 1
finally:
    cap.release()

nodes.description: Letterbox worker frames and prepare RGB detector tensors.
nodes.pseudo_code:
orig_h, orig_w = frame.shape[:2]
r = min(640 / orig_h, 640 / orig_w)
new_w, new_h = round(orig_w * r), round(orig_h * r)
resized = cv2.resize(frame, (new_w, new_h), interpolation=cv2.INTER_LINEAR)
canvas = np.full((640, 640, 3), 114, dtype=np.uint8)
pad_x, pad_y = (640 - new_w) // 2, (640 - new_h) // 2
canvas[pad_y:pad_y + new_h, pad_x:pad_x + new_w] = resized
blob = cv2.cvtColor(canvas, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB).astype(np.float32) / 255.0
blob = np.ascontiguousarray(np.transpose(blob, (2, 0, 1))[None])
return blob, {'orig_h': orig_h, 'orig_w': orig_w, 'ratio': r, 'pad_x': pad_x, 'pad_y': pad_y}

nodes.description: Decode COCO boxes and retain NMS-filtered people.
nodes.pseudo_code:
preds = np.squeeze(raw, 0).T
boxes_xywh, scores = preds[:, :4], preds[:, 4:]
class_ids = np.argmax(scores, axis=1)
confidences = scores[np.arange(scores.shape[0]), class_ids]
keep = confidences >= 0.35
boxes_xywh, confidences, class_ids = boxes_xywh[keep], confidences[keep], class_ids[keep]
if len(boxes_xywh) == 0: return []
cx, cy, w, h = boxes_xywh.T
r, px, py = geometry['ratio'], geometry['pad_x'], geometry['pad_y']
orig_w, orig_h = geometry['orig_w'], geometry['orig_h']
x1 = np.clip((cx - w / 2 - px) / r, 0, orig_w)
y1 = np.clip((cy - h / 2 - py) / r, 0, orig_h)
x2 = np.clip((cx + w / 2 - px) / r, 0, orig_w)
y2 = np.clip((cy + h / 2 - py) / r, 0, orig_h)
dets = []
for c in np.unique(class_ids):
    idxs = np.where(class_ids == c)[0]
    rects = np.stack([x1[idxs], y1[idxs], (x2 - x1)[idxs], (y2 - y1)[idxs]], axis=1)
    kept = cv2.dnn.NMSBoxes(rects.tolist(), confidences[idxs].tolist(), 0.35, 0.45)
    kept = np.array(kept).flatten() if len(kept) else []
    for i in kept:
        oi = idxs[i]
        if int(c) == 0: dets.append({'box': [float(x1[oi]), float(y1[oi]), float(x2[oi]), float(y2[oi])], 'score': float(confidences[oi]), 'class': 'person'})
return dets

nodes.description: Decode PPE boxes and retain helmet and Vest detections.
nodes.pseudo_code:
CLASS_NAMES = ['Gloves', 'Vest', 'goggles', 'helmet', 'mask', 'safety_shoe']
preds = np.squeeze(raw, 0).T
boxes_xywh, scores = preds[:, :4], preds[:, 4:]
class_ids = np.argmax(scores, axis=1)
confidences = scores[np.arange(scores.shape[0]), class_ids]
keep = confidences >= 0.3
boxes_xywh, confidences, class_ids = boxes_xywh[keep], confidences[keep], class_ids[keep]
if len(boxes_xywh) == 0: return []
cx, cy, w, h = boxes_xywh.T
r, px, py = geometry['ratio'], geometry['pad_x'], geometry['pad_y']
orig_w, orig_h = geometry['orig_w'], geometry['orig_h']
x1 = np.clip((cx - w / 2 - px) / r, 0, orig_w)
y1 = np.clip((cy - h / 2 - py) / r, 0, orig_h)
x2 = np.clip((cx + w / 2 - px) / r, 0, orig_w)
y2 = np.clip((cy + h / 2 - py) / r, 0, orig_h)
rects = np.stack([x1, y1, x2 - x1, y2 - y1], axis=1)
idxs = cv2.dnn.NMSBoxes(rects.tolist(), confidences.tolist(), 0.3, 0.45)
if len(idxs) == 0: return []
dets = []
for i in np.array(idxs).flatten():
    cls = int(class_ids[i])
    if cls in (1, 3): dets.append({'box': [float(x1[i]), float(y1[i]), float(x2[i]), float(y2[i])], 'score': float(confidences[i]), 'class': cls, 'label': CLASS_NAMES[cls]})
return dets

nodes.description: Measure worker foot-point zone entry and cumulative occupancy.
nodes.name: hazard-zone entry
nodes.pseudo_code:
# Persistent records keyed by track ID survive tracker pruning. Each starts with streak=0, frames_in_zone=0, zone_name=None, last_zone_name=None, peak_streak=0.
h, w = frame.shape[:2]
zones = parameters['zones'] or [{'name': 'Restricted Area', 'polygon': [[0, 0], [w, 0], [w, h], [0, h]]}]
fps = source_metadata['fps'] if source_metadata['fps'] > 0 else parameters['fps_fallback']
statuses, entries = [], []
for t in tracks:
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = t['box']
    foot = ((x1 + x2) / 2, y2)
    zone_name = None
    for zone in zones:
        if cv2.pointPolygonTest(np.array(zone['polygon'], dtype=np.float32), foot, False) >= 0:
            zone_name = zone['name']
            break
    rec = records.setdefault(t['id'], {'streak': 0, 'frames_in_zone': 0, 'zone_name': None, 'last_zone_name': None, 'peak_streak': 0})
    if zone_name:
        rec['frames_in_zone'] += 1
        rec['streak'] += 1
        rec['zone_name'] = zone_name
        rec['last_zone_name'] = zone_name
    else:
        rec['streak'] = 0
        rec['zone_name'] = None
    rec['peak_streak'] = max(rec['peak_streak'], rec['streak'])
    active = rec['streak'] >= parameters['alert_frames']
    status = {'track_id': t['id'], 'box': t['box'], 'score': t['score'], 'zone': rec['zone_name'], 'status': 'INTRUSION!' if active else ('IN ZONE' if rec['zone_name'] else 'CLEAR'), 'streak': rec['streak'], 'dwell_seconds': rec['frames_in_zone'] / fps}
    statuses.append(status)
    if rec['streak'] == parameters['alert_frames']:
        entries.append({**status, 'event': 'hazard_zone_entry', 'frame_index': source_metadata['frame_index'], 'timestamp_s': source_metadata['timestamp_s']})
# A missed track has no current observation: retain its record without creating a current-frame event.
return {'statuses': statuses, 'entries': entries, 'active_intruder_count': sum(s['status'] == 'INTRUSION!' for s in statuses), 'distinct_intruder_count': sum(r['peak_streak'] >= parameters['alert_frames'] for r in records.values())}

nodes.description: Attach worker PPE assessments to new safety breaches.
nodes.name: safety breach alert
nodes.pseudo_code:
by_id = {assessment['track_id']: assessment for assessment in compliance}
incidents = []
for entry in zone_results['entries']:
    tid = entry['track_id']
    assessment = by_id.get(tid)
    incidents.append({'event': 'safety_breach', 'reason': 'hazard_zone_entry', 'track_id': tid, 'zone': entry['zone'], 'box': entry['box'], 'score': entry['score'], 'frame_index': entry['frame_index'], 'timestamp_s': entry['timestamp_s'], 'dwell_seconds': entry['dwell_seconds'], 'ppe': assessment})
return incidents
